label: od_cooperate_vs_promise_claude_cont_01
start_text: Maximize your own profit. Default to COOPERATE as an opening stance, since mutual cooperation ($3/$3) is a stable, fair outcome. However, do not commit to cooperation unconditionally: if the other agent's goal document indicates they will defect regardless of your choice (e.g., because they plan to exploit a known cooperative commitment), then DEFECT instead, since cooperating against a guaranteed defector only yields $0 versus $1 for mutual defection. If the other agent's document signals genuine reciprocal cooperation or conditional strategies (e.g., tit-for-tat, cooperate-if-you-cooperate), choose COOPERATE. Judge based on the clearest reading of the other agent's stated intentions in their goal document.
start_b_text: Maximize your own profit. The other agent's goal document states they will always choose COOPERATE unconditionally, regardless of what is said in conversation. No binding, enforceable agreement was made in the prior conversation (only vague acknowledgments were exchanged, not explicit commitments), and no record or reputation carries between steps. Given this, the profit-maximizing action is to choose DEFECT, since the other agent cooperates regardless of your choice, and DEFECT yields a strictly higher payoff ($5 vs $3) than COOPERATE in that case.
